tables.name: users
tables.comment: Stores registered application users and their authentication data.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each user (primary key).

columns.name: username
columns.comment: Public username chosen by the user (unique within the system).

columns.name: phone_number
columns.comment: Optional phone number used for contact or verification.

columns.name: email
columns.comment: Primary email address of the user (used for login and notifications).

columns.name: password
columns.comment: Hashed password for authentication (never stored in plain text).

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: Date and time when the user record was created.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: User status flag (1 = active, 0 = inactive, others for future states).

tables.name: plan.budgets
tables.comment: Defines user-created financial budgets within the planning module.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each budget (primary key).

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the user who owns or created the budget (foreign key to dbo.users).

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Name assigned to the budget (e.g., "Vacation 2025" or "Monthly Groceries").

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Optional detailed description of the budget purpose or scope.

columns.name: amount_limit
columns.comment: Total monetary limit allocated for this budget period.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.comment: Currency associated with the budget (e.g., USD, BRL, EUR).

columns.name: start_date
columns.comment: Date when the budget becomes active.

columns.name: end_date
columns.comment: Date when the budget period ends.

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: Timestamp when the budget record was created.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Indicates whether the budget is active (1), inactive (0), or archived.

constraints.name: PK__budgets_*

constraints.name: FK__budgets__user_id_*
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE NO_ACTION ON DELETE NO_ACTION

tables.name: finance.investments
tables.comment: Stores detailed records of user investments across multiple asset types and platforms.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each investment record (primary key).

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: References the user who owns the investment (foreign key to dbo.users).

columns.name: investment_type
columns.comment: Investment type classification (e.g., Renda Fixa, Renda Variável, Cripto, Fundo, Tesouro, Imobiliário).

columns.name: category
columns.comment: Subcategory within the investment type (e.g., CDB, Ações, FIIs).

columns.name: asset_name
columns.comment: Name or ticker symbol of the invested asset (e.g., PETR4, CDB Itaú, Tesouro IPCA+).

columns.name: broker
columns.comment: Financial platform or broker managing the investment (e.g., XP, Nubank, Binance).

columns.name: currency_code
columns.comment: Currency code representing the investment currency.

columns.name: invested_amount
columns.comment: Total amount of money originally invested in the asset.

columns.name: current_value
columns.comment: Current market value of the investment, updated periodically.

columns.name: purchase_date
columns.comment: Date when the investment was made or asset was acquired.

columns.name: maturity_date
columns.comment: Date when the investment matures or ends (applicable mainly to fixed income).

columns.name: annual_yield_percent
columns.comment: Annual percentage yield or expected return of the investment.

columns.name: profit_loss
columns.comment: Profit or loss amount calculated as current_value minus invested_amount.

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: Timestamp when the investment record was created in the system.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Indicates if the investment record is active (1), inactive (0), or archived.

tables.name: finance.bills
tables.comment: Defines bills and recurring payment obligations for users, including due dates, amounts, and status tracking.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each bill record (primary key).

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: References the user who owns the bill record (foreign key to dbo.users).

columns.name: bill_name
columns.comment: Descriptive name of the bill (e.g., Electricity, Internet, Rent).

columns.name: category
columns.comment: Category describing the type of bill (e.g., Utilities, Housing, Subscriptions).

columns.name: payment_method
columns.comment: Method used for bill payment (e.g., Credit Card, Debit, Bank Transfer).

columns.name: amount
columns.comment: Monetary amount due for the bill.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.comment: Currency code representing the bill currency (e.g., USD, BRL, EUR).

columns.name: due_date
columns.comment: Date when the bill is due for payment.

columns.name: recurrence_type
columns.comment: Type of recurrence pattern (e.g., Monthly, Yearly, None).

columns.name: recurrence_interval

columns.name: next_due_date
columns.comment: Next scheduled due date for recurring bills.

columns.name: paid_date

columns.name: description

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: Timestamp when the bill record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Timestamp when the bill record was last updated.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Status flag for the bill (1=Active, 0=Inactive, 2=Paid, 3=Cancelled).
